title: How avatarin built a 24/7 retail agent with GPT-Realtime
summary_lines: avatarin uses OpenAI’s GPT-Realtime to give Yamada Denki shoppers 24/7 multilingual support. In two weeks, 30,000 people used the agent and 92% of survey responses were positive.
